answer.rationale: Current data shows activation down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion down 4% QoQ. While competitor pricing pressure exists, the immediate operational problem is internal activation degradation. Memory_91 (activation messaging) and memory_86 (onboarding improvement) are both directly relevant to this decline. Activation_messaging offers a lower-risk, faster-iteration path compared to pricing changes (which memory_73 shows pooled cohorts and require careful interpretation) or referral incentives (memory_57 shows success but works on established base, not new activation). Memory_31 (signup simplification) combined with memory_86 and memory_91 suggests the activation funnel has multiple leverage points. Testing activation_messaging as a standard experiment targets the week-one engagement drop directly and can be validated quickly. This preserves the option to address pricing competition with data-driven promotional tactics if activation messaging alone proves insufficient, rather than committing to aggressive pricing immediately. Verification of memory_86 and memory_91 will confirm the magnitude and durability of prior gains before replicating them.
